fullText: Cognitive biases are systematic tendencies that can influence judgment even when people believe they are reasoning objectively. Improving decisions may require redesigning the context in which choices are made.

fullText: Statistical significance indicates how surprising an observed result would be under a particular mathematical assumption, but it does not automatically show that the result is important in practice.
